title: gatto.json
description: settings that apply to every project. gatto writes this file next to the schema it names, and rewrites the schema on every launch.

$schema.description: points at this file. gatto accepts the key and never reads its value, so editing it changes nothing gatto does and no type is declared here.

endpoints.description: every place gatto can talk to a model. each key names one endpoint.

base_url.description: the server address, an absolute http or https url. only the endpoint named local may omit it.

key_env.description: name of the environment variable holding the api key. gatto reads the variable, never the key itself.

context.description: context window in tokens, used as the budget for this endpoint.

thinking.description: per level request fields for a model that exposes reasoning effort. each value is an object or null.

models.description: the model names this endpoint offers. /model lists them, a launch with no -m and no saved default takes the first, and a model outside the list is refused.

default_endpoint.description: which endpoint gatto opens on. a key under endpoints, or the name of an endpoint an extension contributes; checked at launch.

default_model.description: older form of defaults.<default_endpoint>.model. gatto reads it as that and moves it there on its next write.

defaults.description: what was chosen per endpoint. each key names an endpoint; an entry for an endpoint that no longer exists is ignored.

model.description: the model a launch on this endpoint takes when -m and the role name none.

effort.description: the effort saved per model on this endpoint, a level name per model id.

default_publisher.description: which publisher the model shelf opens on. the list is compiled in, so adding one needs a new gatto release. leave it out to use the shipped default.

llama_server.description: path to the llama-server executable that gatto serve starts.

context_files.description: which project notes gatto reads at launch.

compat.description: also read other harnesses context files, not only GATTO.md.

home.description: read the GATTO.md in your gatto folder as the first layer, under any project file.

theme.description: colour palette. auto probes the terminal background.

glyphs.description: which glyph vocabulary to draw. auto reads the host: unicode on Windows Terminal and VS Code, ascii on a legacy console with no glyph for the marks.

reasoning.description: how reasoning is displayed. collapsed streams then folds to one row, expanded stays open.

regions.description: accepted and ignored. the display mode it selected no longer exists, and gatto still loads a file that carries it.

search.description: which providers web_search uses, and their settings. listing tavily requires search.tavily.apiKey, and listing searxng requires search.searxng.url, or gatto refuses to start.

providers.description: the provider chain, tried in order. a provider succeeds when it returns at least one result.

apiKey.description: your tavily api key, stored in this file as text.

url.description: the instance address, an absolute http or https url.

weights_root.description: the folder new model files are fetched into, and the folder gatto scans for gguf files that have no model profile yet.

think.description: session default for a model whose reasoning is a switch. absent leaves the server default.

alt_screen.description: use the alternate screen. false keeps gatto on the main screen and in native scrollback.

dump_on_exit.description: print the whole transcript to the main screen when gatto exits.

stop_server_on_exit.description: stop llama-server when you leave gatto with /quit or with Ctrl+C. closing the window does not stop it. leave this off when two gatto windows use one server, because the first window to quit stops the server for both.

mouse.description: capture the mouse for wheel scrolling and click to expand. off when alt_screen is false.

copy_on_select.description: copy a mouse selection to the clipboard when the drag ends.

auto_compact.description: when to compact the conversation, as a fraction of the context window. false turns it off.

deny_reason.description: after denying a tool call, offer to type a reason the model will read.

memory.description: the memory files gatto may write and recall.

enabled.description: allow memory. false stops memory_write and keeps memory out of the prompt.

index_budget.description: tokens the memory index may use. unset lets gatto derive it from the context window.

update_check.description: may gatto ask github whether a newer release exists. absent means never asked, and nothing is sent.

extensions.description: settings for installed extensions, one object per extension name. gatto checks only that each value is an object; the extension reads its own keys.
